posts.title: CVE-2026-110912: Arpbleed
posts.description: CVE-2026-110912 is my first published CVE! The fix is merged upstream and the record is live in the database. It lives in a 23-year-old corner of DragonFly BSD. The ARP input path trusts two one-byte length fields from any packet on the wire. posts.description: Craft is a medium Hack the Box machine and the whole thing is one mistake repeated four times.
